question: What is the sequence of the sleep rite and what does the sleeping disciple perceive?
premises: The guru should enter the heart-wheel again in this manner.
This constitutes the sequence of the sleep rite.
When sleep has arrived, the disciple perceives the stainless moon and sun.
inference: The repeated heart-wheel entry defines the sleep rite and culminates in the disciple's vision of the stainless moon and sun.
uncertainties: The exact number of repetitions is not stated.
plain_english: He should enter the heart-wheel again in this way; this is the sequence of the sleep rite. When sleep has come, this disciple perceives the stainless moon and sun.
